name: Security 48
definition: Data specific to securities being subject to the transaction.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as ISIN (International Securities Identification Number-ISO 6166) identifier are matching or not.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as CFI (Classification of Financial Instruments-ISO 10962) identifier are matching or not.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as decimal number are matching or not.

NominalValue.name: Nominal Value
NominalValue.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as active or historic currency and amount are matching or not.

Quality.name: Quality
Quality.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as collateral quality type code are matching or not.

Maturity.name: Maturity
Maturity.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as ISO date are matching or not.

IssuerIdentification.name: Issuer Identification
IssuerIdentification.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as LEI identifier are matching or not.

IssuerCountry.name: Issuer Country
IssuerCountry.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as country code are matching or not.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as securities lending type are matching or not.

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Specifies whether the the unit prices are matching or not.

ExclusiveArrangement.name: Exclusive Arrangement
ExclusiveArrangement.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as true/false indicator are matching or not.

MarketValue.name: Market Value
MarketValue.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as active or historic currency and amount are matching or not.

AvailableForCollateralReuse.name: Available For Collateral Reuse
AvailableForCollateralReuse.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as true/false indicator are matching or not.

HaircutOrMargin.name: Haircut Or Margin
HaircutOrMargin.definition: Collateral haircut, a risk control measure applied to underlying collateral whereby the value of that underlying collateral is calculated as the market value of the assets reduced by a certain percentage. |In the case of margin lending, collateral haircut or margin requirement, a risk control measure applied to the entire collateral portfolio whereby the value of that underlying collateral is calculated as the market value of the assets reduced by a certain percentage. |Only actual values, as opposed to estimated or default values are to be reported for this attribute.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: Following Must be True|    /Identification Must be present| Or /ClassificationType Must be present| Or /Quantity Must be present| Or /NominalValue Must be present| Or /Quality Must be present| Or /Maturity Must be present| Or /IssuerIdentification Must be present| Or /IssuerCountry Must be present| Or /Type Must be present| Or /UnitPrice Must be present| Or /ExclusiveArrangement Must be present| Or /MarketValue Must be present| Or /AvailableForCollateralReuse Must be present| Or /HaircutOrMargin Must be present
